verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents a dedicated data analytics, protection and privacy practice that resolves privacy and data protection law issues across European jurisdictions, with partners practising in the area since the 1990s. It also runs a separate cyber security practice covering incident preparation, response and recovery. Missing for 10: explicit naming of GDPR, CCPA or DPDP-specific counsel, any evidence of non-European privacy regimes, and independent or third-party corroboration.
